    Profile

    Hazel is a mercenary from Slothstein with an artificial limb. Rather than collecting fame, she's the type of person who rather wield her powers to protect her loved ones. Though she's not great with words, she's actually easy to understand due to the joyful sparkles in her eyes. She loves getting people she's fond of to try her favorite cheese dogs.

    Origin: Slothstein
    Gender: Female
    Height: 158cm
    Weight: 48kg
    Birthday: Apr 19
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Flame King
    Likes: Cheese dogs
    Hobbies: Street food
    Illust: 渡り棒
    CV: 中村繪里子
